Abilities that cannot be copied are As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Teraform Zero, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Trace, Zen Mode, and Zero to Hero. If no opposing Pokemon has an Ability that can be copied, this Ability will activate as soon as one does.
desc.zhHans: 出场时，复制对手的特性，变为与之相同的特性。

shortDesc.en: This Pokemon's offensive stat is multiplied by 1.3 while using an Electric-type attack.
shortDesc.zhHans: 电属性的招式威力会提高。

shortDesc.en: This Pokemon's healing moves have their priority increased by 3.
shortDesc.zhHans: 可以率先使出回复招式。

shortDesc.en: This Pokemon skips every other turn instead of using a move.
shortDesc.zhHans: 如果使出招式，下一回合就会休息。

shortDesc.en: This Pokemon's moves and their effects ignore the Abilities of other Pokemon.
shortDesc.zhHans: 可以不受对手特性的干扰，向对手使出招式。

desc.en: This Pokemon's moves and their effects ignore certain Abilities of other Pokemon. The Abilities that can be negated are Armor Tail, Aroma Veil, Aura Break, Battle Armor, Big Pecks, Bulletproof, Clear Body, Contrary, Damp, Dazzling, Disguise, Dry Skin, Earth Eater, Filter, Flash Fire, Flower Gift, Flower Veil, Fluffy, Friend Guard, Fur Coat, Good as Gold, Grass Pelt, Guard Dog, Heatproof, Heavy Metal, Hyper Cutter, Ice Face, Ice Scales, Illuminate, Immunity, Inner Focus, Insomnia, Keen Eye, Leaf Guard, Levitate, Light Metal, Lightning Rod, Limber, Magic Bounce, Magma Armor, Marvel Scale, Mind's Eye, Mirror Armor, Motor Drive, Multiscale, Oblivious, Overcoat, Own Tempo, Pastel Veil, Punk Rock, Purifying Salt, Queenly Majesty, Sand Veil, Sap Sipper, Shell Armor, Shield Dust, Simple, Snow Cloak, Solid Rock, Soundproof, Sticky Hold, Storm Drain, Sturdy, Suction Cups, Sweet Veil, Tangled Feet, Telepathy, Tera Shell, Thermal Exchange, Thick Fat, Unaware, Vital Spirit, Volt Absorb, Water Absorb, Water Bubble, Water Veil, Well-Baked Body, White Smoke, Wind Rider, Wonder Guard, and Wonder Skin. This affects every other Pokemon on the field, whether or not it is a target of this Pokemon's move, and whether or not their Ability is beneficial to this Pokemon.
desc.zhHans: 可以不受对手特性的干扰，向对手使出招式。

shortDesc.en: This Pokemon ignores other Pokemon's stat stages when taking or doing damage.
shortDesc.zhHans: 可以无视对手能力的变化，进行攻击。

desc.en: This Pokemon ignores other Pokemon's Attack, Special Attack, and accuracy stat stages when taking damage, and ignores other Pokemon's Defense, Special Defense, and evasiveness stat stages when dealing damage.
desc.zhHans: 可以无视对手能力的变化，进行攻击。

shortDesc.en: Speed is doubled on held item loss; boost is lost if it switches, gets new item/Ability.
shortDesc.zhHans: 失去所持有的道具时，速度会提高。

desc.en: If this Pokemon loses its held item for any reason, its Speed is doubled as long as it remains active, has this Ability, and is not holding an item.
desc.zhHans: 失去所持有的道具时，速度会提高。

shortDesc.en: While this Pokemon is active, it prevents opposing Pokemon from using their Berries.
shortDesc.zhHans: 让对手紧张，使其无法食用树果。

desc.en: While this Pokemon is active, it prevents opposing Pokemon from using their Berries. This Ability activates before hazards and other Abilities take effect.
desc.zhHans: 让对手紧张，使其无法食用树果。

shortDesc.en: This Pokemon's contact moves ignore the target's protection, except Max Guard.
shortDesc.zhHans: 如果使出的是接触到对手的招式，就可以无视守护效果进行攻击。

shortDesc.en: Active Pokemon without this Ability have their Special Attack multiplied by 0.75.
shortDesc.zhHans: 在场时，除该特性的宝可梦外，其他特性的宝可梦的特攻降低为原本的75%

shortDesc.en: This Pokemon and its allies' moves have their accuracy multiplied by 1.1.
shortDesc.zhHans: 自己和同伴的命中率会提高。

shortDesc.en: This Pokemon cannot fall asleep. Gaining this Ability while asleep cures it.
shortDesc.zhHans: 通过激发出干劲，不会变为睡眠状态。

shortDesc.en: This Pokemon heals 1/4 of its max HP when hit by Electric moves; Electric immunity.
shortDesc.zhHans: 受到电属性的招式攻击时，不会受到伤害，而是会回复。

desc.en: This Pokemon is immune to Electric-type moves and restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, when hit by an Electric-type move.
desc.zhHans: 受到电属性的招式攻击时，不会受到伤害，而是会回复。

shortDesc.en: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon have their Ability swapped with this one.
shortDesc.zhHans: 与使用接触类招式攻击自己的宝可梦互换特性。

desc.en: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon have their Ability swapped with this one. Does not affect Pokemon with the Abilities As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.
desc.zhHans: 与使用接触类招式攻击自己的宝可梦互换特性。

shortDesc.en: This Pokemon heals 1/4 of its max HP when hit by Water moves; Water immunity.
shortDesc.zhHans: 受到水属性的招式攻击时，不会受到伤害，而是会回复。

desc.en: This Pokemon is immune to Water-type moves and restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, when hit by a Water-type move.
desc.zhHans: 受到水属性的招式攻击时，不会受到伤害，而是会回复。

shortDesc.en: This Pokemon's Water power is 2x; it can't be burned; Fire power against it is halved.
shortDesc.zhHans: 降低自己受到的火属性招式的威力，不会灼伤。

desc.en: This Pokemon's offensive stat is doubled while using a Water-type attack. If a Pokemon uses a Fire-type attack against this Pokemon, that Pokemon's offensive stat is halved when calculating the damage to this Pokemon. This Pokemon cannot be burned. Gaining this Ability while burned cures it.
desc.zhHans: 降低自己受到的火属性招式的威力，不会灼伤。

shortDesc.en: This Pokemon's Defense is raised 2 stages after it is damaged by a Water-type move.
shortDesc.zhHans: 受到水属性的招式攻击时，防御会大幅提高。

shortDesc.en: This Pokemon cannot be burned. Gaining this Ability while burned cures it.
shortDesc.zhHans: 将水幕裹在身上，不会变为灼伤状态。

shortDesc.en: If a physical attack hits this Pokemon, Defense is lowered by 1, Speed is raised by 2.
shortDesc.zhHans: 如果因物理招式受到伤害，防御会降低，速度会大幅提高。

desc.en: If a physical attack hits this Pokemon, its Defense is lowered by 1 stage and its Speed is raised by 2 stages.
desc.zhHans: 如果因物理招式受到伤害，防御会降低，速度会大幅提高。

shortDesc.en: This Pokemon's Defense is raised 2 stages if hit by a Fire move; Fire immunity.
shortDesc.zhHans: 受到火属性的招式攻击时，不会受到伤害，而是会提升2级防御

shortDesc.en: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's stat stages.
shortDesc.zhHans: 被白色烟雾保护着，不会被对手降低能力。

shortDesc.en: This Pokemon switches out when it reaches 1/2 or less of its maximum HP.
shortDesc.zhHans: ＨＰ变为一半时，会慌慌张张逃走，退回同行队伍中。

desc.en: When this Pokemon has more than 1/2 its maximum HP and takes damage bringing it to 1/2 or less of its maximum HP, it immediately switches out to a chosen ally. This effect applies after all hits from a multi-hit move. This effect is prevented if the move had a secondary effect removed by the Sheer Force Ability. This effect applies to both direct and indirect damage, except Curse and Substitute on use, Belly Drum, Pain Split, and confusion damage.
desc.zhHans: ＨＰ变为一半时，会慌慌张张逃走，退回同行队伍中。

shortDesc.en: This Pokemon gains the Charge effect when hit by a wind move or Tailwind begins.
shortDesc.zhHans: 受到风的招式攻击或己方使用顺风时，会进入充电状态

shortDesc.en: Attack raised by 1 if hit by a wind move or Tailwind begins. Wind move immunity.
shortDesc.zhHans: 受到风的招式攻击或己方使用顺风时，提升1级攻击。不受风的招式影响。

shortDesc.en: This Pokemon can only be damaged by supereffective moves and indirect damage.
shortDesc.zhHans: 不可思议的力量，只有效果绝佳的招式才能击中。

shortDesc.en: Status moves with accuracy checks are 50% accurate when used on this Pokemon.
shortDesc.zhHans: 成为不易受到变化招式攻击的身体。

desc.en: Non-damaging moves that check accuracy have their accuracy changed to 50% when used against this Pokemon. This effect comes before other effects that modify accuracy.
desc.zhHans: 成为不易受到变化招式攻击的身体。

shortDesc.en: If Darmanitan, at end of turn changes Mode to Standard if > 1/2 max HP, else Zen.
shortDesc.zhHans: ＨＰ变为一半以下时，样子会改变。

desc.en: If this Pokemon is a Darmanitan or Galarian Darmanitan, it changes to Zen Mode if it has 1/2 or less of its maximum HP at the end of a turn. If Darmanitan's HP is above 1/2 of its maximum HP at the end of a turn, it changes back to Standard Mode.
desc.zhHans: ＨＰ变为一半以下时，样子会改变。

shortDesc.en: If this Pokemon is a Palafin in Zero Form, switching out has it change to Hero Form.
shortDesc.zhHans: 回到同行队伍后，会变为全能形态
